title: UI Pattern Registry 的确定性自然语言检索层
summary: 将 Pattern 的稳定 ID、双语名称、别名、Intent、Use When、Anatomy、Realization 与 Validation 编入机器可读索引；自然语言请求先由确定性词汇/字符相似度解析到候选 Pattern，再由代理根据上下文选择，而不是靠记忆猜测 Pattern 名称。
principles: Exact Pattern IDs and aliases outrank fuzzy similarity.
Search results expose maturity and evidence gaps rather than hiding them.
Retrieval returns Realization and Validation references with the semantic Pattern.
The retrieval layer does not change Pattern maturity or Canonical status.
